author: petr1petr
body:
yes, mage class will use questing staff (2x, dual wield) in dungeons even on T10 and T11

T10 has alternative Arisen Terror - but it gives less gold and no exp.

masterforge, demonforge and godforge will further increase the bonus.

there is a hidden info spreadsheet that shows these things - it is a bit confusing when you first look at it, but you should be able to understand it after a while..

[https://orna.guide/gameplay?show=17](https://orna.guide/gameplay?show=17)

just to add - melee classes have it a bit different, so because of element on questing weapons, they will rather use venin and questing weapon in other hand, so that the element will not play a role..
